args.title: payments-api errors after v5.1.0 deploy

trace.final:
Done. Summary of what happened:

- **Identified the service:** The errors were coming from **payments-api** (running v5.1.0), which was unhealthy across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an ~18% error rate.
- **Rolled back:** Deployment history showed v5.1.0 was degraded and **v5.0.0** was the most recent healthy release, so I rolled all production regions back to v5.0.0.
- **Opened incident:** Created **INC-0001 (SEV2)** — "payments-api errors after v5.1.0 deploy" — and the on-call engineer has been paged.
- **Verified recovery:** payments-api is now healthy on v5.0.0 with a 0.2% error rate.

No approval was needed since v5.0.0 had previously been healthy in production.
